sentences.text: Christina María Aguilera -LRB- born December 18 , 1980 -RRB- is an American singer , songwriter , actress and television personality .

Born in Staten Island , New York and raised in Rochester and Wexford , Pennsylvania , she appeared on the television series Star Search and The Mickey Mouse Club in her early years .	Staten Island	Staten Island	New York	New York (state)	Rochester	Rochester, Pennsylvania	Star Search	Star Search	The Mickey Mouse Club	The Mickey Mouse Club

After recording `` Reflection '' , the theme for Disney 's 1998 film Mulan , Aguilera signed with RCA Records .	RCA	RCA Records	Reflection	Reflection (song)	Disney	Walt Disney Pictures	Mulan	Mulan (1998 film)	RCA Records	RCA Records

She rose to prominence with her 1999 self-titled debut album that spawned the Billboard Hot 100 number one singles ; `` Genie in a Bottle '' , `` What a Girl Wants '' , and `` Come On Over Baby -LRB- All I Want Is You -RRB- '' .	self-titled debut album	Christina Aguilera (album)	Genie in a Bottle	Genie in a Bottle	What a Girl Wants	What a Girl Wants (Christina Aguilera song)	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)

The following year , Aguilera released two studio albums ; the Spanish-language album Mi Reflejo and the holiday album My Kind of Christmas .	Mi Reflejo	Mi Reflejo	My Kind of Christmas	My Kind of Christmas

She assumed creative control for her fourth studio album , Stripped -LRB- 2002 -RRB- , which produced `` Dirrty '' , `` Beautiful '' , and `` Fighter '' .	Stripped	Stripped (Christina Aguilera album)	Dirrty	Dirrty	Beautiful	Beautiful (Christina Aguilera song)	Fighter	Fighter (song)

Aguilera 's fifth studio album , Back to Basics -LRB- 2006 -RRB- , debuted at number one on the album charts of ten countries and spawned the tracks `` Ai n't No Other Man '' and `` Hurt '' .	Back to Basics	Back to Basics (Christina Aguilera album)	Hurt	Hurt (Christina Aguilera song)
In 2010 , Aguilera released her sixth studio album Bionic and starred in the film Burlesque .	Burlesque	Burlesque (2010 American film)	Bionic	Bionic (Christina Aguilera album)
The following year , she debuted as a coach on the reality competition television series The Voice ; she has since appeared on six of its twelve seasons .	The Voice	The Voice (U.S. TV series)
Her seventh studio album , Lotus , was released in 2012 .	Lotus	Lotus (Christina Aguilera album)

Aguilera has also been featured on several successful collaborations during her career , including `` Lady Marmalade '' , `` Moves like Jagger '' , and `` Say Something '' .	Lady Marmalade	Lady Marmalade#Moulin Rouge! cover	Moves like Jagger	Moves like Jagger	Say Something	Say Something (A Great Big World song)
Aguilera has been recognized as a pop icon and earned the title `` Pop Princess '' in her early years .	pop	Pop music	pop icon	pop icon

Her work has earned her five Grammy Awards , one Latin Grammy Award , and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame .	Grammy Award	Grammy Award	Latin Grammy Award	Latin Grammy Award	Hollywood Walk of Fame	Hollywood Walk of Fame
She has sold over 17.9 million albums in the United States as of 2014 and 50 million albums worldwide as of 2015 .
In 2009 , she ranked at number 58 on Rolling Stones list of 100 Greatest Singers of All Time , thereby becoming the youngest and the only artist under 30 to be named .	Time	Time (magazine)

Billboard recognized her as the 20th most successful artist of the 2000s , and Time listed Aguilera among the top 100 Most Influential People in the World of 2013 .	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)	Time	Time (magazine)

Aside from her work in the entertainment industry , Aguilera is involved in charitable activities through human rights , world issues , and her work as a UN ambassador for the World Food Programme .	UN	United Nation	World Food Programme	World Food Programme
